# Prashanth T. (StarOne01)

> Systems Engineer based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. Works the gap between hardware and software: compilers, model inference, and the systems that make AI run efficiently on real silicon.

Prashanth T. (@StarOne01) is a self-taught Systems Engineer and final-year Electrical & Electronics Engineering student. He started coding on a phone through Termux before owning a laptop, and now builds production clinical AI, contributes to LLVM (16 contributions and counting), and is going deep on compiler internals and MLIR. Stack: Go, Python, C++ (favorite), TypeScript/Next.js, LLVM/MLIR, QLoRA, Qdrant.

## About
- [Bio](https://starone01.me/#about): Final-year EEE student, Termux-to-production origin, now focused on MLIR and compiler internals
- [Expertise](https://starone01.me/#about): Compilers & LLVM, Production ASR & Clinical AI, ML Systems & Inference, Embeddings & Retrieval
